definitions.converged: status=converged AND final normalized gap <= configured tolerance; passed certificates over a library budget are not silently accepted as converged timings
definitions.time: Median/IQR only among converged runs. Final-iterate recovery retains unconverged runs, with counts and converged-only summaries alongside.
definitions.uncertainty: Five paired synthetic seeds describe instance variation, not confidence intervals. Leukemia repeats describe timing on one fixed dataset.
definitions.thresholds: Basic solver checkpoints only; observed crossing upper bounds, not interpolation. skglm initial/fit endpoints are excluded.
definitions.cold_start: Solver elapsed plus dense SVD for ISTA/FISTA; data preparation and one-time library compilation/loading are separate.
definitions.exact_recovery: Empirical success counts/rates over the observed seeds, not a high-precision probability estimate.
definitions.structural_diagnostics: Computed using known synthetic truth; not finite-sample guarantees. Global Hessian condition is not reported for p>n.

structure.interpretation: True-support Gram/irrepresentable values are diagnostics, not finite-sample recovery guarantees; full Hessians are singular for p>n-1.

support_sensitivity.interpretation: 0.01/0.05 change the statistical estimator by fixed post-thresholding; no threshold was selected using test performance.

algorithm_agreement.interpretation: Agreement uses only methods passing the final common criterion; partial-method sets are identified by their count.

synthetic.interpretation: All tolerance-ladder refits and posterior checks are included in elapsed time. Library fits cannot be interrupted at the exact wall-clock cap.

uji.interpretation: All tolerance-ladder refits and posterior checks are included in elapsed time. Library fits cannot be interrupted at the exact wall-clock cap.

leukemia.interpretation: All tolerance-ladder refits and posterior checks are included in elapsed time. Library fits cannot be interrupted at the exact wall-clock cap.

uji.scope: UJI longitude random held-out regression; validation selects lambda, test is not used for selection.

leukemia.scope: One fixed 72-observation binary-label squared-loss optimization task; repeats describe timing, not new datasets or prediction validation.
